title: Meerschaum Performance
description: Native Meerschaum sync telemetry and recorded Pipeline runs. Time filters apply to completed syncs. Data visibility follows the selected PostgreSQL data source permissions. No raw sync messages or SQL are stored in these metrics.

list.name: schema
list.label: Internal schema
list.definition: SELECT table_schema AS __text, table_schema AS __value FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' OR starts_with(table_name, 'mrsm_engine_metrics_') GROUP BY table_schema ORDER BY CASE WHEN table_schema='_mrsm_internal' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, table_schema
list.query: SELECT table_schema AS __text, table_schema AS __value FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' OR starts_with(table_name, 'mrsm_engine_metrics_') GROUP BY table_schema ORDER BY CASE WHEN table_schema='_mrsm_internal' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, table_schema

list.name: metrics_table
list.label: Instance schema
list.definition: SELECT CASE WHEN table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' THEN 'Default instance' ELSE substr(table_name,length('mrsm_engine_metrics_')+1) END AS __text, table_name AS __value FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=${schema:sqlstring} AND (table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' OR starts_with(table_name,'mrsm_engine_metrics_')) ORDER BY table_name
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' THEN 'Default instance' ELSE substr(table_name,length('mrsm_engine_metrics_')+1) END AS __text, table_name AS __value FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=${schema:sqlstring} AND (table_name='mrsm_engine_metrics' OR starts_with(table_name,'mrsm_engine_metrics_')) ORDER BY table_name

list.name: pipeline
list.label: Pipeline
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' AS __text, snapshot->>'name' AS __value FROM "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m ON m.run_id=r.run_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts) AND snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT '(No Pipeline)', '(No Pipeline)' ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' AS __text, snapshot->>'name' AS __value FROM "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m ON m.run_id=r.run_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts) AND snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT '(No Pipeline)', '(No Pipeline)' ORDER BY 1

list.name: pipe
list.label: Pipe
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT connector_keys || ' / ' || metric_key || ' / ' || COALESCE(location_key, 'None') AS __text, pipe_ref AS __value FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT connector_keys || ' / ' || metric_key || ' / ' || COALESCE(location_key, 'None') AS __text, pipe_ref AS __value FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Syncs" FROM selected

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS "Failures" FROM selected

panels.title: Rows affected
panels.description: Inserted + updated + upserted + deleted rows. Replacements count both deletion and writing; unchanged fetched or checked rows are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))

SELECT COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(rows,0)),0) AS "Rows" FROM selected

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '$__interval'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE success) AS "Successful", count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS "Failed" FROM selected GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Write rate
panels.description: Rows affected divided by total measured sync duration. Concurrent sync durations are summed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '$__interval'), sum(COALESCE(rows,0)) / NULLIF(sum(duration_seconds),0) AS "Rows affected/s" FROM selected GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '$__interval'), 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "Failure rate" FROM selected GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT pipe_ref AS "Pipe", count(*) AS "Syncs", round(avg(duration_seconds)::numeric,3) AS "Average seconds", round(max(duration_seconds)::numeric,3) AS "Maximum seconds", count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS "Failures", sum(COALESCE(rows,0)) AS "Rows affected", sum(greatest(attempts-1,0)) AS "Retries" FROM selected GROUP BY pipe_ref ORDER BY avg(duration_seconds) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recent failures
panels.description: Telemetry records outcomes and timing; open the corresponding run or job in the console for logs.

targets.rawSql:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)) > 0 THEN ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT snapshot->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.selection, '')::jsonb->'pipeline_definitions', '[]'::jsonb)) snapshot WHERE snapshot->>'name' IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE ARRAY['(No Pipeline)']::text[] END AS pipeline_names
  FROM "${schema:raw}"."${metrics_table:raw}" m LEFT JOIN "${schema:raw}"."${runs_table:raw}" r ON r.run_id = m.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts)
), selected AS (
  SELECT * FROM events WHERE ('__all' IN (${pipe:sqlstring}) OR pipe_ref IN (${pipe:sqlstring}))
    AND ('__all' IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) OR pipeline_names && ARRAY[${pipeline:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND ('__all' IN (${result:sqlstring}) OR success::text IN (${result:sqlstring}))
)
SELECT ts AS "Completed", pipe_ref AS "Pipe", run_id AS "Run", duration_seconds AS "Seconds", attempts AS "Attempts", chunks AS "Chunks", source AS "Source" FROM selected WHERE NOT success ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100
